card.name: Number of doses per day
card.fires_on: The word after 'in a', 'as a' or 'in' that gives how many doses a daily amount is split into, such as 'single' or 'two' before 'dose' or 'divided doses'. It also fires on 'in' after 'administered' in the same setting.

modes.label: Single or two doses
modes.description: 'single' or 'two' right before 'dose' or 'divided doses' in dosing instructions.
modes.example: The usual dosage range is 20 mg to 40 mg per day administered in a<< single>> daily dose.

modes.label: In after administered
modes.description: The word 'in' following 'administered' just before a dose-split phrase.
modes.example: The total daily colchicine tablets dose may be administered<< in>> one to two divided doses.

modes.label: Infusion duration
modes.description: The space before a number of minutes in an infusion time.
